newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Grenfell gets Gawler Craton go-ahead.
newsitem.headline: Grenfell gets Gawler Craton go-ahead.

text.p: Gold explorer Grenfell Resources NL said on Tuesday that it had successfuly concluded an agreement with various Aboriginal parties over its exploration programme in the Gawler Craton region in South Australia.
Grenfell said the agreement gave it clearance to carry out all types of exploration under a two year programme.
The only restrictions were in areas not critical to its programme, the company said.
The Gawler Craton shot to prominence as a gold region late in 1996 on the back of impressive drilling results in the area.
